initial.title: C-SDLC v2 publish cannot represent non-closing incremental parent checkpoints
initial.goal: Represent closing and non-closing publication linkage explicitly and safely.
initial.required_outcome: Publication accepts a typed closing or part_of mode, retains that mode through remote evidence, and never treats part_of as terminal issue authority.
authority_boundary: GitHub remote PR state remains publication observation authority
Only closing linkage may establish terminal issue authority
operator_constraints: No shell or Python control plane
Use COTS serde, schemars, and strum already present
Run focused Rust tests only before publication
initial.task_boundary: Add one typed publication linkage mode and carry it through publication, observation, evidence, and finish.
deliverables: Exact same-repo and split-repo linkage validation
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: closing mode preserves current exact closing-keyword behavior
AC-2: part_of accepts only an exact non-closing Part of reference
AC-3: split-authority part_of references are repository-qualified
AC-4: mixed, ambiguous, or mismatched linkage fails closed
AC-5: intent, remote observation, and publication evidence retain linkage_mode
AC-6: finish cannot close or terminalize an issue from part_of evidence
AC-7: omitted mode remains compatible as closing
dependencies: Current C-SDLC v2 publication and finish contracts
initial.plan_summary: Introduce a small strum-backed linkage enum, validate exact body syntax, retain it end to end, and prove terminal closeout remains closing-only.

steps.action: Add linkage_mode to request, intent, evidence, schema, and compatibility decoding.
Implement exact closing and part_of body validation for same and split repository authority.
Carry observed mode through reconciliation and make finish reject non-closing terminal authority.
Run focused publication and finish regressions and exact-head review.

risks: Backward compatibility drift for existing requests
A part_of PR accidentally becoming closeout authority
stop_conditions: GitHub cannot expose enough evidence to distinguish modes
Scope expands outside publication and finish contracts

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove typed mode parsing, same/split exact references, ambiguity rejection, compatibility default, and retained intent evidence.
Prove only closing merged publication evidence may produce terminal issue authority.
Prove the generated publication schemas include the typed linkage enum and compatibility default.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on absent or ambiguous linkage, unqualified split authority, remote mismatch, or any part_of terminalization.
review_prompts: Can part_of ever reach terminal finish authority?
Are same and split repository references exact and non-ambiguous?
Does omitted mode preserve existing closing requests without weakening validation?
initial.review_scope: Publication linkage types, exact parsing, retained evidence, remote reconciliation, finish authority, and focused tests only.
